newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange quiet, awaiting direction.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange quiet, awaiting direction.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange remained quiet on Wednesday with volume at 1,281 kg versus Tuesday's 1,134 kg.
Traders were sidelined, awaiting developments as prices fluctuated, dealers said.

Gold closed easier on the day at $318.00 an ounce and 1,535,000 lira per gram, compared to Tuesday's close of $322.05 and 1,560,000 lira, after a brief recovery in the afternoon session following movements on European markets.
The Turkish currency closed at 150,900 lira to the dollar, weaker than Monday's 150,590, cushioning gold's fall in lira terms.
Almost all of the day's trade -- 1,221 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 73.8 percent of the total volume conducted in lira terms.
